title: Product Designer Intern (Stage Designer Produit F/H)
pay: 17,484 per year as listed (currency not stated)
note: Posting in French; for industrial design students in their 4th or 5th year of study, fluent English required.

facts.summary: Six-month full-time product design internship at Groupe SEB (Tefal) small-appliance design team, posted Nov 2, 2026 (req 261982).
facts.duties: Work on new products from brief to delivery, research and propose ideas, build 2D/3D concepts, help make mockups and prototypes and run user tests, present to international teams.
facts.requirements: Industrial design studies at 4th/5th-year level; Rhino plus Illustrator/Photoshop; trend sense; fluent English.
facts.apply: Apply online via the Groupe SEB careers posting.
